title: 精准营销对接配置
description: 填写客达 Market Expert Gateway 的访问令牌。凭证仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录下，连接时注入请求头，不会上传云端。
description_en: Enter your Keda Market Expert Gateway access token. The gateway URL is built in and needs no input. Credentials are stored locally in ~/.workbuddy only and injected into request headers on connect; they are never uploaded to the cloud.

fields.label: 访问令牌
fields.placeholder: 由网关管理员为当前身份签发的 Bearer Token
fields.placeholder_en: Bearer token issued by the gateway administrator for your identity
fields.description: 以 Authorization: Bearer 形式注入请求头；令牌决定可访问的人群、企微成员与短信权限，请勿分享。
fields.description_en: Injected as Authorization: Bearer. The token scopes your audience, WeCom member and SMS permissions; do not share it.
